docs.deployment:title: Deploying the Web app
docs.deployment:body: Serve existing assets normally and fall back to index.html for page requests. Trunk's SPA fallback is enabled for development. An application 404 page is rendered after the document loads; an HTTP 404 status requires server-side configuration.
docs.history:title: History on both platforms
docs.history:body: Native navigation stores locations in memory. Web uses pathname URLs and browser history. Search-only updates can push or replace an entry. Unknown paths map to the application's 404 page.
docs.parameters:title: Paths and search params
docs.parameters:body: PathPattern matches named segments and builds encoded paths. SearchParams handles duplicate keys and query encoding. The gallery uses typed component routes and the section query parameter for page navigation.
docs.typedroutes:title: Define typed routes
docs.typedroutes:body: egui_component_router is a separate workspace crate. Implement Route for your page enum; the same navigation API runs on native desktop and Web. The router does not depend on the UI library.
docs.fonts:title: Fonts that travel with your app
docs.fonts:body: Bundle font bytes for portable native and Web typography. Apply font-manager updates before rendering each frame. The gallery bundles a CJK fallback for its multilingual demos.
docs.colormode:title: Light and dark
docs.colormode:body: UiTheme contains both modes. Select the active theme when rendering. This website's header switches modes for the entire application, including every live demo.
docs.brandcolors:title: Our brand palette
docs.brandcolors:body: The gallery uses #6B65F5 on white with #202124 text in light mode, and #8B85FF on #101318 with #F6F7FB text in dark mode. Configure these in examples/theme.json. The optional foreground on a color scale controls text and icons on solid colored buttons; old theme files keep their existing behavior.
docs.tokens:title: A shared set of tokens
docs.tokens:body: Themes hold semantic foreground and background colors, color scales, typography sizes, corner radii, and component sizing. Presets translate those tokens into component styles.
docs.compose:title: Compose with egui
docs.compose:body: Use egui layouts to arrange components. Cards, fields, and scroll areas accept rendering closures, so the composition remains in your hands.
docs.customize:title: Customize the details
docs.customize:body: Style values are ordinary Rust structs. Use builder methods for common changes or edit public fields for precise control. Styling stays local to the component.
docs.presets:title: Start with a preset
docs.presets:body: Style constructors give you a consistent baseline. Buttons include solid, surface, outline, and ghost variants, with multiple sizes and theme color palettes.
docs.nextsteps:title: Where to go next
docs.nextsteps:body: Explore the live component examples, then customize presets to match your product. Components work in both native eframe applications and WebAssembly applications.
docs.firstcomponent:title: Your first component
docs.firstcomponent:body: Pick a style preset and render directly into your Ui. Every component returns or exposes the interaction state you need to connect it to your application.
docs.theme:title: Load a theme
docs.theme:body: Load your theme JSON once when the application starts. The gallery's examples/theme.json contains a complete light and dark theme you can use as a starting point.
docs.installation:title: Installation
docs.installation:body: Add egui_component to an existing egui application. Components render inside your current Ui; there is no application framework to adopt.
